model.description: Google's GA high-efficiency model for low-latency, high-volume and simple extraction workloads.

selection_evidence.local_positive: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite completed 50 small decomposed Lolla calls, including preserved failures, for $0.076058862 in the closed V1 affordable investigation.
selection_evidence.local_caveat: The model is not a production default and has not been tested on this exact unresolved/reopen plus exact-ID relationship contract.
selection_evidence.why_not_gemini_3_5: The premium V1 campaign cost $3.1495905, still produced false stand-downs, and is retained only as benchmark evidence.
selection_evidence.why_not_deepseek_v4_flash_now: DeepSeek is cheaper and remains a later comparison candidate, but the current experiment tests a new semantic decomposition; changing both decomposition and model family would make the first causal diagnostic less interpretable.
selection_evidence.why_not_openai: The founder selected Gemini through OpenRouter for this research path; this snapshot does not route semantic calls through OpenAI.

non_claims: Advertised capability does not prove schema acceptance or source fidelity.
Prior small-task success does not establish this task, production reliability, or comparative usefulness.
Endpoint pricing and availability are point-in-time facts that must be refreshed before a later experiment.
